description: High-level vacuum control action for an ESP32-controlled end-effector line.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should receive the vacuum control command.

inputs.label: Enabled
inputs.description: Turn the vacuum line on or off.

advanced_inputs.label: Vacuum Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin that toggles the vacuum solenoid or relay.

advanced_inputs.label: Exhaust Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Optional runtime GPIO pin for a vent/exhaust solenoid.

outputs.label: Status
outputs.description: Future confirmation returned by the vacuum controller.
